summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Phase 4: Harden Recall — Reliability, Performance, Privacy, and Release Readiness. Covers persistent incremental indexing with exponential backoff for failed images, Room schema migration (v4->v5) for retry tracking, rigorous memory/bitmap safety, repeatable multi-metric search evaluation (Recall@5, Precision@5, nDCG@5 across visual, text, and hybrid queries), and release readiness verification.
